summary: Frontend-only test of /jobs white-screen fix and /map Google Maps fix (logged in as chattest@example.com). MAP: fully working - real Google Map renders (data-testid=google-map), 64 location markers, no google-map-error, no Google Maps key errors in console (only Marker deprecation warning + expected headless Geolocation error), clicking a marker opens details dialog, list below map renders. JOBS: page no longer goes white - header, search, location presets, 12 category chips (Todos, Construção, Limpeza...) render and category click works (shows Sugestões). BUT tabs Plataformas / Serviços / Procuram render an EMPTY content area: JobsPage.js only has a `viewMode === 'search'` render block; no blocks for 'platforms', 'offers', 'seekers'. searchAllPlatforms/searchOnPlatform/displayData are defined but never used, so the 'search across platforms' button does not exist in UI. 'Buscar Vagas' calls backend /api/jobs search which returns 503 'configure RAPIDAPI_KEY' (shown as toast; no crash).
